rulings.subsequentHistory: The Fourth District affirmed, holding that the unfitness and best-interest findings were not against the manifest weight of the evidence.

rulings.judgeRole: Trial judge, Robert C. Bollinger; not a member of the appellate panel.
rulings.topic: Police accountability, domestic violence, and labor arbitration
rulings.proceduralStage: Judicial review of a police-reinstatement arbitration award
rulings.holding: Bollinger set aside an arbitration award that would have reinstated a police officer after a suspension, following findings of domestic battery and dishonesty by a preponderance of the evidence.
rulings.reasoning: He applied the narrow public-policy exception: Illinois policy protecting domestic-violence victims and requiring police truthfulness made continued employment improper in these circumstances, despite the usual deference to labor arbitration.
rulings.subsequentHistory: The Fourth District affirmed. It rejected the union's statutory and evidentiary objections and agreed that reinstatement in these circumstances violated public policy.

rulings.judgeRole: Trial judge, Jason M. Bohm; not a member of either reviewing court.
rulings.topic: Local executive authority and appointments to elected-office vacancies
rulings.proceduralStage: Summary judgment in a statutory declaratory-judgment action
rulings.holding: Bohm granted summary judgment to the county executive, holding that she had power to fill vacancies in elected county offices, including county-board seats.
rulings.reasoning: He read the County Executive Law's appointment language and governmental structure as transferring the appointment function to the county executive. He did not prohibit the board from using the title of chair.
rulings.subsequentHistory: The Fourth District reversed in 2021. On November 28, 2022, the Illinois Supreme Court unanimously affirmed that reversal: the Election Code assigns those elected-office appointments to the county-board chair; the executive's general appointment statute did not override it.
